body.name: full-rank two-class collision witness
body.construction: For \(k=d_x=d_z=2\), let \(P_{\varepsilon}^{\mathrm{wit}}\) satisfy \(P(U=1)=0.4\), \(P(U=2)=0.6\), \(P(T=1\mid U=1)=0.4\), \(P(T=1\mid U=2)=0.6\), \(X=(1,X_2)^\top\), \(Z=(1,Z_2)^\top\), \(B=\begin{psmallmatrix}1&1\\0.2&0.8\end{psmallmatrix}\), \(A_0=\begin{psmallmatrix}1&1\\0.3&0.7\end{psmallmatrix}\), \(A_1=\begin{psmallmatrix}1&1\\0.35&0.75\end{psmallmatrix}\), \(E[Y(0)\mid U]=(0.25,0.25)\), and \(E[Y(1)\mid U]=(0.5-\varepsilon,0.5+\varepsilon)\). Conditional on \(U\), draw \(X_2,Y(0),Y(1),T\) mutually independently as Bernoulli variables with the stated conditional means; conditional on \(U,T\), draw \(Z_2\) independently of \((X_2,Y(0),Y(1))\) with mean given by \(A_T\), and set \(Y=Y(T)\).
